{
  "name": "frontend",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vite",
    "build": "tsc --noEmit && vite build",
    "preview": "vite preview",
    "typecheck": "tsc -b --noEmit"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@radix-ui/react-scroll-area": "^1.2.3",
    "@radix-ui/react-separator": "^1.1.2",
    "@radix-ui/react-slot": "^1.1.2",
    "@tanstack/react-query": "^5.67.2",
    "class-variance-authority": "^0.7.1",
    "clsx": "^2.1.1",
    "lucide-react": "^0.479.0",
    "react": "^19.0.0",
    "react-dom": "^19.0.0",
    "react-markdown": "^10.1.0",
    "remark-gfm": "^4.0.1",
    "sonner": "^2.0.1",
    "tailwind-merge": "^3.0.2"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@tailwindcss/vite": "^4.0.12",
    "@types/react": "^19.0.10",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19.0.4",
    "@vitejs/plugin-react": "^4.3.4",
    "tailwindcss": "^4.0.12",
    "typescript": "^5.8.2",
    "vite": "^6.2.1"
  }
}

{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "useDefineForClassFields": true,
    "lib": ["ES2022", "DOM", "DOM.Iterable"],
    "module": "ESNext",
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "allowImportingTsExtensions": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "moduleDetection": "force",
    "noEmit": true,
    "jsx": "react-jsx",
    "strict": true,
    "noUnusedLocals": true,
    "noUnusedParameters": true,
    "noFallthroughCasesInSwitch": true,
    "noUncheckedSideEffectImports": true,
    "baseUrl": ".",
    "paths": {
      "@/*": ["src/*"]
    }
  },
  "include": ["src"]
}

{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "lib": ["ES2022", "DOM", "DOM.Iterable"],
    "module": "ESNext",
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "allowImportingTsExtensions": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "moduleDetection": "force",
    "noEmit": true,
    "strict": true
  },
  "files": [],
  "references": [{ "path": "./tsconfig.json" }]
}

{
  "name": "notes-app",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "description": "Production-ready Simple Note app with Bun, Elysia, React, and SQLite",
  "workspaces": [
    "backend",
    "frontend"
  ],
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "concurrently \"bun run --filter backend dev\" \"bun run --filter frontend dev\"",
    "dev:backend": "bun run --filter backend dev",
    "dev:frontend": "bun run --filter frontend dev",
    "build": "bun run --filter frontend build && bun run --filter backend build",
    "start": "bun run --filter backend start",
    "migrate": "bun run --filter backend migrate",
    "db:generate": "bun run --filter backend db:generate",
    "db:migrate": "bun run --filter backend migrate",
    "typecheck": "bun run --filter backend typecheck && bun run --filter frontend typecheck"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "concurrently": "^9.1.2"
  }
}
